_comment: Per-project Claude Code settings for the AI co-mathematician system. The hooks below enforce the discipline described in Zheng et al. (2026), section 3.3-3.4: paper.tex edits cannot introduce un-justified theorems or hand-waving (in strict mode), and a workstream cannot be marked complete without an explicit reviewer approval file. To relax strict mode for this project, edit co-math-config.json (set strict_mode to false) and record the rationale in decisions.md.
